timeline.why: Kane found no way to refuse cookies, and 2 tracker requests went out before the visitor made any choice.
timeline.kaneSummary:
The requested task was to open a page from the site navigation and reload it.
No cookie or analytics consent banner was displayed, so no consent action was needed.
Opened the Subscribe page from the site navigation and reloaded it successfully.

timeline.summary:
The Google tag was hardcoded in every page's `<head>` and loaded straight away, so it ran before any choice and the site had no way to decline.

In `server.js` I removed that static tag and added an Accept/Decline banner. The tag now loads only when the stored choice is "accepted", or right after the visitor clicks Accept. On first visit, and after Decline, nothing loads. `node --check server.js` passes, but I haven't run the app or re-run Kane against it.

timeline.why: Kane refused cookies and recorded 11 requests; none went to a known tracker and no visitor ID was sent.
